query: Which slag‑specific CRMs or synthetic reference materials validate LA‑ICP‑MS and isotope workflows for high‑Ca/high‑Fe matrices beyond NIST 610/612 and BHVO‑2?

response.query: Which slag‑specific CRMs or synthetic reference materials validate LA‑ICP‑MS and isotope workflows for high‑Ca/high‑Fe matrices beyond NIST 610/612 and BHVO‑2?
response.answer: For high-Ca/high-Fe matrices, the USGS BCR-2 and the IGGE GSR 1-6 slag-specific CRMs validate LA-ICP-MS and isotope workflows. These materials are used beyond NIST 610/612 and BHVO-2.

results.title: 0195-5373 JUL/AUG 2025 - e-ISSN: 2708-521X Vol. 46 No. 4
results.content: To validate the reliability of trace and major elements, four USGS reference materials (BCR-2, BHVO-2,. AGV-2, and RGM-2) and six IGGE RMs (GSR 1-6) were.
